title: 第3章 你有几条命？
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

张宁也假装没听见统子哥的蛐蛐，谎话张嘴就来，“方才旁人送来的吃食，一起吃点吧。”

县衙内，谁会给殿下送这么丰盛的吃食？

凝香一愣，但就算已经被馋得直咽口水了，却仍想也不想地拒绝，“殿下，这，这如何使得？奴婢身份卑微，怎可与殿下同桌而食？”

就知道是这样。

凝香的反应，完全在张宁的意料之中。

他故意沉下脸，没好气道：“想什么呢？本皇子是让你过来试吃。不然你以为，我为什么等到现在，都没有动筷？”

原来如此。

凝香顿时不惶恐了，“是，殿下。”

然后就拿起筷子，夹了一小块鱼脸肉，放入口中。

没看出来，你还是个老吃家呢，张宁不由得，多看了凝香一眼。

“唔，好鲜、好嫩。”凝香惊呼出声，激动道，“殿下，这鱼肉比皇城醉仙居做的还要好吃呢。”

连张宁这个六皇子，来到这鸟不拉屎的荒山县，都只能吃面片汤、水煮白菜帮子，更遑论是她这个婢女了。

冷不丁吃到这么好吃的食物，她简直想哭。

“好吃那你就多吃一点。”张宁也夹起一块鱼脸肉。

凝香面露疑惑，“殿下，你不是让奴婢试吃吗？”

“鱼头没毒，不代表鱼尾也没毒。”张宁理所当然道，“既然是试吃，当然要试吃到底，每个部位都要浅尝一下。”

凝香狐疑地看了眼张宁，怎么觉得，殿下是以此为由，忽悠自己陪他吃饭呢？

但她却没敢多问，生怕自己又自作多情了，只得在张宁的要求下，不断试吃。

直到一盏茶后，她才有些不好意思地摸了摸微微隆起的小肚子，“殿下，奴，奴婢吃饱了。”

“真巧，我也吃饱了。”张宁也放下了筷子。

统子哥还是很给力的，说是双人套餐，可实际上，两人一顿风卷残涌后，也就只吃了不到一半而已。

太好了，还能再吃一顿。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhang Ning also pretended not to hear Brother Tongzi's cricket, and opened his mouth to lie, "Let's eat some of the food someone just brought us."

Who in the county government would give His Highness such a sumptuous meal?

Ningxiang was stunned, but even though she was so greedy that she swallowed her saliva, she still refused without thinking, "Your Highness, how can this be done? How can I eat at the same table with Your Highness as a slave with a low status?"

Just knew it was so.

Ningxiang's reaction was completely within Zhang Ning's expectation.

He deliberately darkened his face and said angrily: "What are you thinking about? This prince wants you to come over and taste it. Otherwise, do you think I didn't use my chopsticks until now?"

That’s it.

Ningxiang suddenly lost her panic, "Yes, Your Highness."

Then he picked up the chopsticks, picked up a small piece of fish face, and put it into his mouth.

I didn't realize that you are still a seasoned foodie. Zhang Ning couldn't help but take another look at Ningxiang.

"Well, it's so fresh and tender." Ningxiang exclaimed and said excitedly, "Your Highness, this fish is even more delicious than the one made by Zuixianju in the Imperial City."

Even Zhang Ning, the sixth prince, could only eat noodle soup and boiled cabbage when he came to this barren mountain county, let alone her maid.

After eating such delicious food, Leng Buding almost wanted to cry.

"It's delicious, then you should eat more." Zhang Ning also picked up a piece of fish face.

Ningxiang looked puzzled, "Your Highness, didn't you let your servant try it?"

"The fish head is not poisonous, but it does not mean that the fish tail is not poisonous." Zhang Ning said matter-of-factly, "Since it is a trial, of course you have to taste it to the end, and you have to taste every part."

Ningxiang glanced at Zhang Ning suspiciously. Why did she think His Highness was using this as an excuse to trick her into eating with him?

But she didn't dare to ask more questions, for fear that she would be too sentimental again, so she had to keep trying at Zhang Ning's request.

It wasn't until she had a cup of tea that she touched her slightly bulging belly with some embarrassment, "Your Highness, slave, slave, I'm full."

"What a coincidence, I'm full too." Zhang Ning also put down his chopsticks.

Brother Tongzi was very good, and said it was a set meal for two people, but in fact, after the two of them had a feast, they only ate less than half of it.

Great, I can have another meal.
